subject: Acuity Health — questions on backup escrow, retention windows and wipe process
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@acuityhealth.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@acuityhealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on backup escrow, retention windows and wipe process

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the chat earlier. Our security questionnaire has a few follow-ups we need to close out before legal will move to SOW review:

1) Do you offer an escrow or immutable backup for tenant data in hosted deployments? If so, where is the escrow stored (region) and who has access?
2) What are the exact retention windows for (a) chat / generation request payloads, (b) embeddings, and (c) logs/traces? We need both default and maximum configurable values.
3) For account termination: what's the guaranteed timeline for complete data wipe from hosted systems, backups, and analytics stores? Is there a certified attestation process?
4) Any differences in process if we request export + delete vs immediate delete without export? Timelines for both.

Could you reply with a concise answer that we can paste into the questionnaire? A PDF or links to your playbook are helpful.

Best,
Elena Park
Security Analyst
Acuity Health

From: lukas_meyer@redwood.example
To: Elena Park <elena@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on backup escrow, retention windows and wipe process

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Below are concise answers you can paste into the Acuity questionnaire. Attaching a short retention summary and our tenant erasure playbook for your auditors (see attachments).

1) Escrow/Backups: Redwood does not maintain customer escrowed data by default for hosted customers. We maintain automated, encrypted backups of model-serving state and infra-level snapshots for disaster recovery. For customers requiring escrow/immutable storage we offer a configurable export workflow to a customer-owned S3 (or partner escrow) bucket and can coordinate write-once retention with our ops. Escrow location is customer-controlled; if you route exports to an Acuity S3 in us-east-1 the data remains in that region. Access is limited to the customer and a small break-glass engineering ops group under MFA and audit logging.

2) Retention windows (hosted API defaults / max configurable):
- Request payloads (input + output): default 30 days; configurable down to 0 days (ephemeral) or up to 365 days on a paid retention add-on.
- Embeddings/derived vectors: default 90 days; configurable to 0 (no storage) or up to 730 days under contract.
- Logs & traces (platform telemetry, error traces): default 365 days for analytics; configurable retention policies available per request.

3) Account termination / data wipe: Standard workflow for hosted tenants:
- Step A: Initiate export (if requested) — typical export window 24–72 hours to prepare and deliver (depends on data volume).
- Step B: Deletion pass — primary data stores are deleted within 7 calendar days after confirmation of deletion.
- Step C: Backups & snapshots — overwritten or pruned on the next scheduled backup cycle; complete removal from backups completed within 90 days (we maintain up to 90 days retention for infra snapshots by default). If you require accelerated wipe from backups we provide a certificate of deletion and can set a shorter agreed SLA under contract (e.g., 30 days) with an operational invoice.
- Attestation: We provide a deletion attestation signed by our security officer and a log of deletion events (ticket id + timestamps). For higher-assurance audits we can produce redacted audit logs and an SOC-2 supported evidence package.

4) Export vs immediate delete: If you request export + delete we will pause deletion until successful export confirmation; export time depends on dataset size (24–72h typical). Immediate-delete requests proceed with the deletion pipeline and follow the timelines above (7 days primary wipe; up to 90 days for backups unless expedited by contract).

Notes / caveats:
- Some downstream analytics (aggregated metrics) may be retained in anonymized, aggregated form — we do not retain PII in aggregated metrics. We can provide examples if needed.
- Regions: Hosted data residency follows the region you choose for your tenant. Metadata about routing (non-content) may persist in control plane logs scoped to the region of operations.

I'll attach the two short documents and can jump on a 20-minute call if you want to run this past your auditor.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention-summary.pdf (summary), tenant-erasures-playbook.md (playbook)

Elena — quick commercial note to add to Lukas' answers:

- If Acuity requires <30-day backup retention or a contractually shortened backup wipe (e.g., 30-day complete removal), we support that as a billable add-on tied to Dedicated or a Compliance Package for hosted. I'll include an estimated delta in the SOW once we confirm the retention SLA.
- We can also enable customer-owned export buckets (no data passes through Redwood S3 for escrow) to simplify compliance.

Happy to coordinate procurement/contract language; looping Marissa for approvals.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

- A signed deletion attestation (PDF) after final wipe;
- Export to your S3 (us-east-1) prior to deletion if you choose export+delete;
- A shortened backup wipe SLA to 30 days under a compliance addendum (to be appended to the MSA). Pricing estimates will come from Ben.

I'll follow up with a redlined compliance addendum and the attestation template. If this meets your needs, Ben and I will draft the SOW language for procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
